name: Summer Fun Club
description_short: A seven-week summer day camp for ages 6-12, held at five Boys & Girls Club sites in Hartford. Kids do arts, science and sports activities, and field trips and meals are included. Camp runs weekdays from 9am to 5pm.

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season (June 29 - August 14, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates, prices and applications are not posted yet.
The dates conflict: the page says "late June to early August" for the seven-week camp, but also lists "June 29 - August 14".

Camp runs at five club locations, each with its own address, phone and contact. No single address, phone or email is recorded: Asylum Hill (170 Sigourney St, 06105, 860-929-7690, swilliams@bgchartford.com), Northwest (1 Nahum Dr, 06112, 860-242-5553, mgarcia@bgchartford.org), South End (129-131 Ledyard St, 06114, 959-255-6472, kingram@bgchartford.org), Southwest (1 Chandler St, 06106, 860-951-6416, lcarrasco@bgchartford.org), Trinity College (1500 Broad St, 06106, 860-727-4154, kmangual@bgchartford.org).
The "$400 early bird special (ends April 6th)" line is unclear. It could mean an early-bird price of $400 or $400 off the $700 fee.
The $700 fee seems to cover the whole 7-week summer, not one week. No weekly rate is stated.
